{{Quote|It is holy relic of the ''Quermian people''! My people! It belongs back at home, not here, in this…this…shrine to wholesale cultural theft!|Needle, on a holy relic taken from Quermia and put on display in the Imperial Museum|<ref name="Star Wars 9">[[Star Wars (2020) 9|''Star Wars'' (2020) 9]]</ref>}}
'''Quermia''' was a terrestrial [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the namesake of the [[Quermian]] [[species]], whose ancestors were settled on Quermia by [[Arkanian]] [[scientist]]s. Quermia was located in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Realspace|space]] during the [[Clone Wars]], isolating it from the [[Galactic Republic]]. Although the extensive [[blockade of Quermia]] was lifted after the Confederacy of Independent Systems [[Mission to Mustafar|collapsed]], the planet fell under [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] rule shortly thereafter.

==Description==
{{Quote|Ride the Perlemian: Coruscant to Quermia.|A poster advertises travel to the planet|<ref name="TBB Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Cornered]]" to [[19 BBY]].</ref>}}
Quermia was a [[planet]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> located in the [[Nilgaard sector]]'s [[Quermia system/Legends|Quermia system]]<ref name="Appendix" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The world was situated in grid square S-5 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Beginner Game" /> A terrestrial world, Quermia's surface featured [[Color|green]] landmasses and expanses of [[ocean]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> It sat close to the end of the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route|hyperlane]],<ref name="Beginner Game" /> which extended north-east from the [[Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant]]<ref name="BMF29">{{BuildFalconCite|29|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> and connected it to the astronomical object [[Makem Te]].<ref name="Beginner Game" /> Quermia also lay at an intersection between the Perlemian Trade Oute and the [[Overic Griplink]] hyperspace route, which linked the world to<ref name="Encylopedia Bespin" /> the planet<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> [[Mon Cala]].<ref name="Encylopedia Bespin" /> A separate [[hyperspace]] route connected Quermia to the planet [[Toola]].<ref name="Beginner Game" /> Quermia was located near the planet [[Troiken]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Xexto]] [[species]].<ref name="Helmet Collection 76">{{HelmetCollectionCite|76|Databank A-Z}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|War has come again! Return to your homes and pray for swift victory or swifter defeat—but first visit the Personal Defense Emporium to prepare for the coming conflagration! Arm yourselves! Arm your families! Ready yourselves with generators, food, and water! Every customer will be entered into our interplanetary raffle for tickets to Alsakan, Quermia, and Lianna!|An announcer, during the protests on Reintegration Day|<ref name="MOF">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref>}}
Long before the [[Imperial Era]], [[Arkanian]] [[scientist]]s settled Quermia with a [[gene]]tic offshoot of the Xexto species. Named for their homeworld, these beings were the ancestors of the [[Quermian]] species.<ref name="Savage Spirits" /> While the origins of the Quermian species were unknown to the larger [[Galaxy|galactic]] community, Quermians and Xexto shared so many of the same genetic markers that [[xenobiologist]]s believed them to share at least a common ancestor. How this came to be was one of [[the galaxy]]'s greatest mysteries.<ref name="Helmet Collection 76" /> A member of the [[Galactic Republic]], Quermia was located in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Realspace|space]] during the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="Savage Spirits" /> a conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems that [[First Battle of Geonosis|began]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Isolated, the planet suffered heavily under an extensive Separatist [[Blockade of Quermia|blockade]].<ref name="Savage Spirits" />

[[File:Yarael_Poof_USW.png|thumb|right|200px|The Quermian Jedi Master Yarael Poof was a native of Quermia.]]
With the fall of the Confederacy at the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the war<ref name="Savage Spirits" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> the [[blockade]] over Quermia was lifted. However, the planet fell under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire]], which the Quermians did not usually consider to be a substantial improvement over Separatist control.<ref name="Savage Spirits" /> In the same year,<ref name="TBB Date" /> Quermia was advertised as a destination worth visiting along the Perlemian Trade Route. One [[Ride the Perlemian|poster]] found on the [[moon]] [[Pantora]] suggested travelers take a flight to the planet aboard [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000|Luxury 3000 space yachts]].<ref name="Cornered Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=cornered-concept-art-gallery|text="Cornered" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> Not many [[Standard month|months]] after the Empire's rise, in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{MOFdate}}</ref> the [[Personal Defense Emporium]] business on the planet [[Coruscant]] held an interplanetary raffle for their customers, prizes including tickets to Quermia, the world [[Alsakan]], and<ref name="MOF" /> the astronomical object<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> [[Lianna]]. As [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] walked through the [[Coruscant Underworld|Coruscant's lower levels]], she heard an [[Unidentified announcer (Coruscant)|announcer]] advertise the promotion via [[Speaker|loudspeaker]].<ref name="MOF" />

By [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars (2020) 9|''Star Wars'' (2020) 9]] to [[3 ABY]].</ref> a [[Quermian holy relic|holy relic]] of the Quermian people had been taken from Quermia and put on display in the [[Galactic Museum|Imperial Museum]] on Coruscant, the [[capital]] of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Star Wars 9" /> Quermia was mentioned as the Quermian homeworld in "[[Species From A to Z]]," a survival compendium sent out by the [[human]] [[Carson Teva]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="OSWM">{{GermanFanCite|114|Database}}</ref> Quermia was later mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archives">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref> The Quermian homeworld was also one of many planets depicted in galactic [[map]]s thought to be drawn by the [[Ithorian]] [[artist]] [[Gammit Chond]]. Unearthed from the Graf Archive's [[Shadow Stacks]], the ancient maps were refurbished by [[Director]] [[Amel Fortoon]] in a [[Galactic Atlas|book]] many years after the [[First Order-Resistance War]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> as well the updated version of the [[book]] no earlier than [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas Updated Edition">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Quermia was the homeworld of<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> the [[garden]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Quermian species,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> who spoke a [[language]] of the [[Quermian (language)|same name]]. After the Arkanians departed Quermia, the Quermians developed a society centered on a largely communal lifestyle, as well as the contemplation of philosophy. The ease at which members of the species were able to communicate and share their feelings and concerns was a contributing factor in how Quermians were able to maintain the long-lasting peace of their society. While Quermia's history was not entirely peaceful, strife usually came from outside influence instead of internal struggles.<ref name="Savage Spirits" />

[[Yarael Poof]], a Quermian [[Jedi Master]] who served on the [[Jedi High Council]] during the final years of the Galactic Republic, hailed from Quermia,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> as did the Quermian [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinder]] [[Needle]]. The latter believed that the Quermian holy relic on display in the Imperial Museum was stolen and should be returned to Quermia.<ref name="Star Wars 9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quermia was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> and first visually depicted in the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', written by [[Emil Fortune]] and illustrated by [[Tim McDonagh]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]] was first mentioned in the [[1999]] book ''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]'', written by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="Episode I Who's Who">''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]''</ref>
